decisions.reason: As the flagship designer shower drain at the core of the firm's design-focused direction, it is very unlikely to be withdrawn.
The shower element with integrated slope fits the trend toward integrated, low-profile floor-level showers, though its minor web presence and the firm's past pruning of shower lines add some risk.
The DallSafe backflow basement drain serves a durable niche need, and products like this typically stay in long-cycle sanitary ranges.
The air-admittance valve is a low-cost complementary item that rounds out the installer range, so keeping it costs little despite it not being a focus.
